release.sh merges committed local work with fetched main, refuses conflicts or non-main checkout, regenerates and checks the exact bumped candidate serially, builds and validates both ZIPs, then atomically pushes main and tag.
A branch or tag race refreshes remote state and repeats generation, checks, and builds. Failed snapshot setup, generation, checks, package gates, or merge conflict exits nonzero before publication.

Installed ZIPs retain backups until unpacked promotion and receipt creation succeed; the unpacked promoter writes the receipt within its rollback boundary. Dirty checkout paths are printed as excluded from the candidate SHA.
